chapter: Offers, Earl Foster and Fats Waller
title: Offers to leave town: telegrams, Earl Hines, Oliver, Fats Waller
summary: Handy says he turned down offers from Earl Hines, Oliver and Fats Waller, and stayed after marriage and his first child; he has old telegrams at home.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Should have brought me a truck. Yeah. When I had a 50-year-old. I wasn't thinking about nothing like that. I had some, uh, a lot of good office to leave here when I was a young man. I still got a lot of telegrams around home there. Yeah. When I fooled around and got married and after I got married my first child was born. I wouldn't leave then. You know, I wouldn't go anywhere.
You want to save all those telegrams and letters, you know.
Yeah, I got them around home there somewhere in some, some of the drawers.
Yeah, we might, can make copies of them. You know, we got a camera to do that.
Like to do it. Uh, who all did you get offers from? What were some of the different people?

I got an offer from Earl Heinz. Who want me to come up? Uh. Yeah. Got off. Uh. Oliver wanted me to come up there with him. I wouldn't leave though. And then we had this fellow, Fat Wallace. He wanted me to come up with him. But I wasn't going no way.
